g.title: PACK
g.text: 11.1 V nominal, 12.6 V full, 10.5 V floor (cutoff V 10.5 in firmware). A pack that reads 6.8 V is dead: never charge it.

g.title: W_PACK
g.text: HOOVO T-plug → OliRC extension → pigtail. Both conductors 14 AWG.

g.title: ESTOP
g.text: E-STOP — NC mushroom switch in the + lead
Latching, twist-release, mounted at deck X −140 (assembly.py). Breaks EVERYTHING on the pack side; the Pi keeps running on the bank.

g.title: WAGO_P
g.text: Lever nut, 24–12 AWG. Slot 1 takes the 14 AWG pigtail, the rest 22 AWG. This and its twin are the ONLY pack-side splices.

g.title: W_SHIELD
g.text: Motor bus: 4 A ramp burst, 20 mV drop

g.title: W_DIV
g.text: Divider: red to Wago +, yellow to A3, black to Wago −

g.title: WAGO_N
g.text: Every return comes back here on its own wire. Never through a board GND pin, never through a USB cable.

g.title: SHIELD_PWR
g.text: CNC Shield v3 — power screw terminal
1000 µF 25 V electrolytic across VMOT/GND at the terminal, stripe (−) to GND. Reversed = vents on first power-up.

g.title: XL4015
g.text: XL4015 5 A buck — trim OUT to 6.0 V
Screw terminals. Set 6.00 V on the meter with nothing on OUT, then wire the PCA9685. Heatsink on. 4 A continuous derated.

g.title: W_SERVO
g.text: 6.0 V servo rail. OUT− → PCA9685 GND terminal is the servo RETURN: its own wire, always.

g.title: LM2596
g.text: LM2596 3 A buck — trim OUT to 5.0 V
Screw terminals. Set 5.00 V on the meter with nothing on OUT. 2 A continuous without a fan. Vin must stay ≥ 6.5 V (pack floor 10.5 V: fine).

g.title: W_LM_OUT
g.text: 5.0 V rail into the sensor Wagos

g.title: W_FAN
g.text: Fan straight off the LM2596 OUT terminals (second wire in the same screw)

g.title: PCA_PWR
g.text: The big 2-pin terminal at the end of the board = servo rail, NOT logic VCC.

g.title: WAGO5_P
g.text: Feeds the four sensor loads; the fan takes its own wire straight off the LM2596 OUT terminal.

g.title: WAGO5_N
g.text: Power returns for the sensors. Each radar ALSO grounds to its CP2102 (signal reference): two GND wires per radar.

g.title: FAN
g.text: 40 mm 5 V fan on the driver heatsinks
Must be a 5 V fan. A 12 V fan goes on the pack Wagos instead — read the label.

g.title: DIV
g.text: Pack-voltage divider on perfboard — 47 kΩ / 10 kΩ
47 kΩ between PACK+ and A3; 10 kΩ between A3 and GND. 12.6 V → 2.21 V at A3 (R4 ADC ref 5 V, VBAT_RATIO 57/10). A3 = the shield's CoolEn pin.

g.title: SHIELD_A3
g.text: CNC Shield v3 — CoolEn header pin (= R4 A3)
The 4-pin block Abort/Hold/Resume/CoolEn on the shield's edge; CoolEn is A3. Its GND is the neighbouring GND pin.

g.title: BANK
g.text: USB power bank 5 V / 3 A (logic island)
Genuine 3 A bank. Cable ≤ 0.3 m, ≥ 24 AWG power conductors. Powers ONLY the Pi; the Pi powers the R4, the hub, the adapters and the webcam.

g.title: W_BANK
g.text: USB-A → USB-C, '3 A fast-charge' cable, ≤ 0.3 m

g.title: PI_PWR
g.text: Under-voltage warning at 4.63 V. Early Pi 4 (rev 1.1) needs an A-to-C or non-e-marked cable.
